open_points.subject: file content digests
open_points.text: “records a file output by its facts only” / “files go to the run's spool through capability:store.spool_file”
open_points.question: Which module and capability computes and verifies the content digest and size of file outputs from the sandbox and service invoker, including trial outputs that are not spooled?
options: module:canonical_values exposes a raw-byte digest capability
module:store computes digests while storing or spooling bytes, with another named capability for unspooled trial outputs
module:sandbox and module:service_invoker compute the facts for their own outputs
open_points.default_guess: Give module:canonical_values one raw-byte SHA-256 digest capability and require functions, runs and effects to use it before recording file facts.

open_points.subject: installed-instance startup validation
open_points.text: “a manifest record that cannot be read or fails a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5) stops the start naming it”
open_points.question: Which exact A08 rule 5 checks apply at startup when check_installed_instances has a service but no operation or proposed ports with which to perform the operation-specific checks?
options: Check only the service-record envelope and the selected instance facts needed for header-collision validation
Validate every capability and operation in the service record
Perform only the credential-header collision check and defer all other manifest validation to proposal or send
open_points.default_guess: Check the service-record envelope and selected instance facts needed for the collision check, and defer operation-specific checks until proposal, acceptance or send.

open_points.subject: effect-run outcome
open_points.text: “The effect sent once, on the exact request the owner was shown or under the owner's grant”
open_points.question: How does this outcome describe a draft-write send, whose stated authority is the flow activation and for which no request is shown to the owner at run time?
options: Add the flow activation as a third authority in this outcome
Restrict this outcome sentence to state-transition, external-effect and destructive sends
Require draft-write sends to use an approval or grant
open_points.default_guess: Add the run's pinned FlowActivation as the third authority, except for a resend after not_applied, which uses a fresh approval.

open_points.subject: effect-run send count
open_points.text: “The effect sent once ... with the declared idempotency key; its EffectAttempt applied, not_applied, not_sent or unknown”
open_points.question: Is the promised outcome exactly one sent request, or at most one send attempt that may conclude not_sent before any request byte is written?
options: Exactly one request is sent, so not_sent is not an outcome here
At most one request is attempted and zero bytes may be sent
The phrase refers only to attempts that reach the transport
open_points.default_guess: State that one request is attempted at most once; a not_sent attempt sends no request byte.
